```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Analysis Summary

```{r summary}
if (!is.null(params$analysis_summary)) {
  kable(params$analysis_summary, caption = "Analysis Parameters") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No analysis summary available.")
}
```

# Dataset Overview

```{r metadata}
if (!is.null(params$metadata)) {
  kable(params$metadata, caption = "Animal Metadata") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No metadata available.")
}
```

# Actograms

## Single-Line Actograms

```{r actograms, fig.cap="Single-line actograms showing locomotor activity patterns"}
if (!is.null(params$plots_data$actograms)) {
  for (i in seq_along(params$plots_data$actograms)) {
    if (!is.null(params$plots_data$actograms[[i]])) {
      print(params$plots_data$actograms[[i]])
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("No actograms generated.")
}
```
